# Group Policy reader (03 §3.5). The value names, kinds and ranges come from the table generated by
# tools/sd-admxgen from res/policy/policies.txt, so the reader cannot drift from the ADMX template.
# tests/policy/check-raw-reads.ps1 fails the build when any other source reads the policy key.

sd_add_module(sd_policy
  SOURCES
    sd_policy.c
  DEPS
    sd_base
  SYSTEM_LIBS
    advapi32
  HEADERS
    include/sd_policy/sd_policy.h)

target_include_directories(sd_policy PUBLIC "${SD_POLICY_DIR}")
add_dependencies(sd_policy sd_policy_gen)
if(TARGET sd_policy_hdrcheck)
  add_dependencies(sd_policy_hdrcheck sd_policy_gen)
endif()
